title: FrameSample
description: Payload: a sparse sample of the camera stream, at most one a second (S9). It records a frame's hash and capture time, never its pixels: in live mode nothing is retained (INV-22), in sweep mode only a face-checked keyframe is kept privately under its hash. Faces inside a detected book box are published cover art and are kept; a face outside every book box has only its region blurred, counted in bystanderRegionsBlurred; a frame where a person dominates, or a face's placement is ambiguous, is dropped and gets no FrameSample (INV-22 as amended 2026-11-02).

hash.description: SHA-256 of the sampled frame's decoded pixels, after any blur. Identifies the frame; the frame itself is not stored in live mode.

capturedAt.description: When the camera captured the frame, from the capture device (the envelope's ts is when the event was written).

frame.description: The extent of the frame; its pixel grid is FramePixels (origin top-left, upright).

mode.description: 'live' for the continuous view, 'sweep' for a guided sweep (OC31).

retention.description: 'none': the frame was not kept. 'keyframe': kept privately for scrub-back (sweep only, INV-22).

bystanderRegionsBlurred.description: How many regions outside every book box were blurred before hashing and any storage. Zero when none.
